name: The new-lawyer pipeline by jurisdiction: bar exam pass rates and new admissions, 2025
description: For every US jurisdiction that reports to the National Conference of Bar Examiners (the 50 states, DC, Guam, the Northern Mariana Islands, Palau, Puerto Rico and the Virgin Islands): the overall 2025 bar exam pass rate, how many new lawyers were admitted in 2025 (by examination, by transferred UBE score and on motion), how admissions by exam or transferred score changed since 2021, and how much of the total came from transferred scores and from motion. Every figure is derived from NCBE's published tables (a rate, a sum, a change, a share) and credited to NCBE with a link to the table it comes from. Where a jurisdiction shows a single admission pathway, the admitted figure is the count NCBE prints for that pathway (The Bar Examiner, statistics for 2025). Each jurisdiction's rows add up to NCBE's own totals row before anything is published.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). The new-lawyer pipeline by jurisdiction: bar exam pass rates and new admissions, 2025 (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23962982

distribution.name: bar-pipeline.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: bar-pipeline.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: bar-pipeline-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in bar-pipeline-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to bar-pipeline.csv on id.

recordSet.name: bar-pipeline
recordSet.description: The records of The new-lawyer pipeline by jurisdiction: bar exam pass rates and new admissions, 2025, one per CSV row.

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter state code, DC, US (federal), ABA, or PLATFORM:<name>

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: year
field.description: The year the figures are for

field.name: pass_rate_pct
field.description: Overall bar exam pass rate for the year (February and July together), in percent: passers divided by takers, as we compute it from NCBE's table. Empty when NCBE shows no results for the jurisdiction.

field.name: admitted
field.description: New lawyers admitted in the year: the sum of the pathways NCBE shows (by examination, by transferred UBE score, on motion). Where NCBE shows a dash for a pathway it is left out and named in admitted_pathways_reported.

field.name: admitted_pathways_reported
field.description: Which admission pathways are in the admitted figure

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: The NCBE tables the figures are derived from

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
